recall.question: A 4:3 photo goes into a 30 × 30 cm frame with no cropping and no stretching. What is the largest size it can be?
recall.why: Uniform scaling keeps the 4:3 ratio, so the width limits it: 30 × 22.5 cm, leaving 7.5 cm of margin. 30 × 30 cm would stretch it; 40 × 30 cm overflows the frame.
